Ivy (partnerships): Heads up  HW partner wants a "high-throughput telemetry" demo for the marketplace listing + SI workshop. They care about traces under sustained GPU load and making sure dashboards don't explode. Can we sketch a demo flow?
Sam (eng): yes. plan: synthetic load generator -> Redwood runtime (enrich spans) -> OTLP proxy (for private) -> Datadog. Need to show both hosted and onprem.
Rajat: for SI audience highlight sampling strategy, buffer/flush behavior when DD is unreachable, and token-cost metrics tied to model_version.
Elena: also include a short legal note for marketplace: embargo screenshot until joint announcement. I'll coordinate with legal.
Sam (eng): minimal OTLP exporter we'll show in the demo app:
```yaml
exporters:
  otlp/datadog:
    endpoint: "https://otlp.datadoghq.com:4317"
    headers:
      DD_API_KEY: "<REDACTED>"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      exporters: [otlp/datadog]
```
Sam (eng): runtime envs for demo: `REDWOOD_TRACE_ENRICH=true`, `REDWOOD_TRACE_SAMPLE_RATE=0.005` (0.5% for prompt_id), `BUFFER_PATH=/var/lib/redwood/trace-buffer`, `FLUSH_INTERVAL=15s`.
Rajat: good. call out that `model` and `model_version` are high-value tags; `prompt_id` should be sampled. SIs need a short card about cardinality and tagging cost.
Ivy (partnerships): GTM kit items: 1) dashboard JSON (p95 latency by model, token-cost by model_version, error flamegraph), 2) OTEL snippets, 3) SI runbook + firewall rules, 4) embargoed screenshot + boilerplate copy.
Elena: legal: will sign off on the screenshot and a 2-line marketplace blurb: "Redwood Inference + Datadog: production telemetry for model serving." will confirm by EOD.
Sam (eng): small note for onprem air-gapped customers: produce a bundle export (tar.gz) that the SI can ship to customer and provide an ingest script that reads from file and `otlp_export` when connectivity is restored. add example command: `rdw-export --bundle /tmp/dd-bundle.tar.gz --forward /var/lib/redwood/trace-buffer`
QA-bot: preflight-check: staging OTLP endpoint reachable from cluster - PASS
Datadog-bot: dashboard-validate: tag usage within limits, widgets ok - OK
Rajat: For the demo script: start synthetic load at 500 rps for 2 minutes, show p95 spike then show how sampling prevents tag explosion. Then toggle `REDWOOD_TRACE_SAMPLE_RATE=0.5` for a short troubleshooting capture.
Ivy (partnerships): timeline proposal:
- Tue EOD: first drafts of dashboard JSON + OTEL snippets (Sam, Rajat)
- Wed AM: dry-run demo + short recording (Sam, Ivy)
- Wed PM: package kit + embargoed screenshot to Legal (Elena)
- Thu: SI workshop slide deck + runbook handoff
Sam (eng): i'll commit otel snippets and demo app to the partner repo and ping here when CI finishes.
Elena: coordinating with Legal now. tagging @Ivy for the screenshot note. :lock: :eyes:
Ivy (partnerships): thanks team. will set up a 20m dry-run call Wed 9am PT. calendar invite incoming. :calendar:
